components.title: BimmerVision
components.description: Continuous four-camera USB recording for iDrive 7 MGU with Surround View. Includes Google Drive Remote Backup over Wi-Fi, horn-triggered clip protection, and phone/computer playback with recorded telemetry. Back up selected recordings using your phone’s internet and view your saved BimmerVision backups at bimmervision.app. Direct capture performs no BMW Drive Recorder subscription check; a car without an entitlement has not yet been physically tested.

components.title: BimmerVision Recorder
components.description: Required recorder service for BimmerVision. Sets up this car automatically; never includes another car’s credentials.
